_comment: This file is a template. ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is resolved by the Cowork plugin
runtime when Dream is installed via the plugin manager.
If you are registering Dream MANUALLY (without the plugin manager), run the
platform-specific setup script instead — it writes the resolved absolute paths:
